verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇਸ੍ਵਾ ਕੇ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਬਿਭਚਾਰ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ  ਬਿਨ ਭਰਤਾਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਕੈ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: besavaiaa ke si(n)gaar bibhachaar ko na paaraavaar  bin bharataar naar kaa kee kai bulaieeaai ||

en.bdb: For immoral acts, there is no end for a whore to do up her ornamentation and embellishment. But without a husband, whose wife would she be called as?

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਗ ਸੇਤ ਗਾਤ ਜੀਵ ਘਾਤ ਕਰਿ ਖਾਤ ਕੇਤੇ  ਮੋਨ ਗਹੇ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਰੇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: bag set gaat jeev ghaat kar khaat kete  mon gahe dhiaan dhare jugat na paieeaai ||

en.bdb: The looks of a heron are like that of a swan but it kills many living beings to eat them up. He silently sits in contemplation but such contemplation cannot reach one to the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਡਾਂਡ ਕੀ ਡੰਡਾਈ ਬੁਰਵਾਈ ਨ ਕਹਿਤ ਆਵੈ  ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਢਿਠਾਈ ਸੁਕੁਚਤ ਨ ਲਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: ddaa(n)dd kee dda(n)ddaiee buravaiee na kahit aavai  at hee ddiThaiee sukuchat na lajaieeaai ||

en.bdb: The shameless words and foul acts of a Bhand (low caste persons who entertain people on their happy functions) are beyond description. Due to their extreme impudence, they never feel shy of saying and doing anything.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਦੋਖ ਮਮ  ਪਤਿਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਏਕ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਾਈਐ ॥੬੪੧॥
verses.translit_en: taise par tan dhan dhookhanaa tiradhokh mam  patit anek ek rom na pujaieeaai ||641||

en.bdb: Similarly, like the incurable and deadly disease, I am infested with the ailments of looking at other's woman, other's wealth and slander. Sins of every hair of my body are more intense than the myriad sins of many sinners.
